title: [12.0] Docs-accuracy pass after the breaking-change batch (adapters/env/Policy/aliases)
body:
**Docs-accuracy pass after the 11.x→12.0 breaking-change batch.** Run once the remaining A-items (#1886, #2377) land. Use the `docs-accuracy-audit` skill + a targeted sweep for the symbols/concepts removed:

### Known doc debt from merged PRs
- **Adapter trim (#2391)** — open edition is now **Hono-only** + MSW removed:
  - `docs/HARDENING.md` — the "Fastify recipe" imports `@objectstack/fastify` (deleted) → rewrite as Hono or drop.
  - `docs/design/driver-turso.md` — "All adapters (Next.js, NestJS, Hono, …)" wording → Hono-only.
  - `../objectui` `e2e/sidebar-text-visibility.spec.ts:27` — stale comment "e.g. via `@objectstack/plugin-msw`".
  - Any website / "supported frameworks" list.
- **Env aliases (#2383)** — `OS_MULTI_TENANT`→`OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED`, `OBJECTSTACK_METADATA_WRITABLE`→`OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`, `AUTH_BASE_URL`/`OS_AUTH_BASE_URL`→`OS_AUTH_URL`; add an UPGRADE note. (ADR-0010 mentions the old metadata-writable env — leave as historical or annotate.)
- **PolicySchema removed (#1882)** — any doc describing `definePolicy` / stack `policies` / "org security policy".
- **Flow http node aliases removed (#2369)** — docs mentioning `http_request`/`http_call`/`webhook` flow node → `http`.
- **IUIService removed (#2374)** / **DriverInterface alias removed (#2378)** — any contract docs.
- **client-react query aliases removed (#2372)** — `select/filters/sort/top/skip` → `fields/where/orderBy/limit/offset`.
- **Open edition = MCP-only (#2325 / 11.0)** — positioning/overview docs.

### Scope
framework `docs/**` (hand-written, not generated) + package READMEs + `../objectui` docs/comments. CHANGELOGs and ADRs are historical — leave unless actively misleading.
